snippet.title: Mega Man X3 (PS1) Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A complete playthrough of Virgin Interactive's 1997 PlayStation game, Mega Man X3.

This is a fair amount different from the far more popular SNES version. The English version also only saw a release in PAL territories, and was never seen in the US until it was included in the Mega Man X collection released several years later. The anime cutscenes are pretty cool, and the remixed music is interesting - the tunes don't feel quite as energetic, but they aren't being played back with the awful samples and extreme reverb present all over the SNES version's soundtrack. The load times are a bit intrusive, but overall, I'd take this over the SNES version any day.

I skipped the red capsule powers to get the gold armor during the first Doppler stage.
_____
No cheats were used during the recording of this video.
